collapses_to.tool: an idempotency-keyed variant of POST /v1/evidence/upload, if one is published

idempotency.verified_at: https://api.noru.tech/llms.txt: "Evidence Upload Guidance" documents POST /v1/evidence/upload, its 50MB cap and its accepted MIME types, and the documented "Idempotency/Upsert Behavior" covers assets and security findings only. No idempotency key is documented for this endpoint, so the piece does not assume one.
idempotency.gap: No idempotency key is documented for this endpoint, so the piece does not rely on one: it embeds the artifact's sha256 in the evidence description and probes getOrganizationEvidence before uploading. A documented idempotency key for evidence — an externalId or a content hash — would let the probe go away.
